result.reason: The redline minimally removes the fixed cutoff and extends the existing conformity warranty to 12 months, while preserving the remedy structure and unrelated terms. However, it does not reach the full playbook position: it adds no professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no separate 90-day services warranty, and no compliance-with-laws warranty. Its malicious-code warranty is also limited to willfully introduced code rather than an unqualified no-malicious-code warranty. In addition, the period runs from the Effective Date rather than acceptance. The drafting is generally clear but retains awkward inherited language and does not distinguish software from services.
